queries:
WITH rates AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds <> 0
  GROUP BY m.Name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates
)
SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.rate - o.avg_rate AS diff_above_average
FROM rates r CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE r.rate > o.avg_rate
ORDER BY r.rate DESC

  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId

assumptions.assumption: Bytes is divided by Milliseconds as real (non-integer) division; tracks with zero Milliseconds are excluded to avoid division by zero (Milliseconds is NOT NULL).
Media types are grouped by name; media types with no tracks that have a non-null Bytes value are not included in the overall average.

assumptions.assumption: Bytes is cast to a real number before dividing so integer division does not truncate the per-track ratio.
Tracks with Milliseconds = 0 are excluded to avoid division by zero. Milliseconds is NOT NULL, so this only drops zero-duration tracks.
A media type with no tracks that have a Bytes value does not appear in the rates, so it is left out of the overall average.

WITH rates AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes IS NOT NULL AND t.Milliseconds <> 0
  GROUP BY m.Name
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM rates
)
SELECT r.Name AS media_type_name, r.rate AS byte_rate, r.rate - o.avg_rate AS difference_from_average
FROM rates r
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE r.rate > o.avg_rate
ORDER BY r.rate DESC;

assumptions.assumption: Media types are grouped by name (as the request states); the media type name is assumed unique, so grouping by name is equivalent to grouping by media type id. Only tracks with a matching MediaType row are used (inner join). Media types with no tracks that have Bytes are excluded from the overall average.
Tracks with Milliseconds = 0 are excluded to avoid division by zero (Milliseconds is NOT NULL, and such rows are unlikely to exist).
Bytes is cast to REAL so division is not integer division; results are unrounded floating-point values.
